gloss: move to and fro, wave, besprinkle
definition: I. [ נוּף ] verb move to and fro, wave, besprinkle (Late Hebrew Hiph`il, Pilpal wave, blow, fan , compare נָפָה sift , נָפָה noun sieve (as Biblical Hebrew); ᵑ7 Aph`el as Biblical Hebrew; Syriac bend, wave, shake ; Di compare Ethiopic quadril. distil, drop like dew ; sift ); — Qal Perfect 1 singular ׳ נַ֫פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִי מֹר וגו Prov 7:17 I have besprinkled my couch with myrrh , etc. Po`lel Imperfect 3 masculine singular ׳ יְנֹפֵף יָדוֺ הַר וגו Isa 10:32 he brandisheth his hand toward the mountain (on accusative הַר compare Ges «GKC:118f»§ 118f . Da Synt. § 69, R 2 ). Hiph`il Perfect 3 masculine singular הֵנִיף Josh 8:31 +, 2 masculine singular הֵנַ֫פְתָּ Exod 20:25 ( Ges «GKC:72k»§ 72k ), וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ Exod 29:24 + 3 t.; 1 singular הֲנִיפֹ֫תִי Job 31:21 Imperfect וַיָּ֫נֶף Lev 8:27 ; Num 8:21 , suffix וַיְנִיפֵ֫הוּ Lev 8:29 2 masculine singular תָּנִיף Deut 23:26 + 2 t., etc.; Imperative masculine plural הָנִ֫יפוּ Isa 13:2 Infinitive construct הָנִיף Isa 10:15 + 2 t.; לַהֲנָפָה Isa 30:28 ( Ges «GKC:72z»§ 72z Ba NB 90 , see also הֲנָחָה ), etc.; Participle מֵנִיף Isa 19:16 ; Zech 2:13 , etc.; — swing, wield, wave: — 1. wield , move tool to and fro in using it, with עַלֿ of material: כִּי חֵרְבְּךָ הֵנַפְתָּ עָלֶיהָ Exod 20:25 ( E ), i.e. over stone, so Deut 27:5 ; Josh 8:31 ( D ), and Deut 23:26 a sickle thou shalt not wield over the standing grain of thy neighbour; absolute מְנִיפוֺ Isa 10:15 against him that wieldeth it (i.e. a saw), and כְּהָנִיף שֵׁבֶט וְאֶתמְֿרִימוֺ v Isa 10:15 (read אֶתֿ ) like a rod's wielding him that lifteth it .2. Shake or wave the hand; \ \ a. wave hand אֶלהַֿמָּקוֺם 2Kgs 5:11 , in healing ceremony (i.e. probably toward sanctuary Kmp Kau ; > toward the spot [where leprosy appears], so most). \ \ b. with עַלֿ , shake or brandish against , Isa 11:15 ; Isa 19:16 ; Zech 2:13 (all of ׳ י ) Job 31:21 [compare Eccl 12:18 (without עַל ) in mockery]. \ \ c. wave hand, as a signal, Isa 13:2 . 3. swing to and fro בְּנָפַת , in a sieve , Isa 30:28 (figurative, of nations). 4. Oft. technical term in P ( H ), of rite in which originally the priest lifted his share of offering and waved it, i.e. moved it toward altar and back, in token of its presentation to God and its return by him to priest: in H , ׳ וְהֵנִיף אֶתהָֿעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי י Lev 23:11 a compare v Lev 23:11 b; v Lev 23:12 , also v Lev 23:20 (on text see Di Dr-Wh Hpt ); in P , וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ אֹתוֺ ׳ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי י Exod 29:26 , so Lev 7:30 ; Lev 8:29 ; Lev 10:15 (object omitted) Num 6:20 thus also Levites are set apart for service of the priests Num 8:11 ( Di strike out see ), v Num 8:13 v Num 8:21 , compare v Num 8:14 ( ׳ לִפְנֵי י omitted); but same phr, of entire lamb, with oil, Lev 14:12 ; Lev 14:24 , and of offerings which were burnt, entirely Exod 29:24 (compare v Exod 29:25 ), Lev 8:27 (compare v Lev 8:28 ), or in part Num 5:25 ( ׳ הֵנִיף הַמִּנְחָה לִפְנֵי י ), — in these the original significance seems lost; so, clearly, of contributions for tabernacle, = offer ׳ הֵנִיף תְּנוּפַת זָהָב לְי Exod 35:22 . — compare תְּנוּפָה below 5. Shed abroad (si vera lectio) גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֺת תָּנִיף Ps 68:10 bounteous rain thou didst shed abroad [compare ], but verb not wholly suitable; Lag Gr proposes תַּטִּיף , yet this also questionable. Hoph`al Perfect 3 masculine singular הוּנַף , be waved , Exod 29:27 ( P ), passive of Hiph`il 4.

Qal Perfect 1 singular ׳נַ֫פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִי מֹר וגו Prov 7:17 I have besprinkled my couch with myrrh, etc. Po`lel Imperfect 3 masculine singular ׳יְנֹפֵף יָדוֺ הַר וגו Isa 10:32 he brandisheth his hand toward the mountain (on accusative הַר compare Ges«GKC:118f»§ 118f. DaSynt. § 69, R 2). Hiph`il Perfect 3 masculine singular הֵנִיף Josh 8:31 +, 2 masculine singular הֵנַ֫פְתָּ Exod 20:25 (Ges«GKC:72k»§ 72k), וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ Exod 29:24 + 3 t.; 1 singular הֲנִיפֹ֫תִי Job 31:21 Imperfect וַיָּ֫נֶף Lev 8:27; Num 8:21, suffix וַיְנִיפֵ֫הוּ Lev 8:29 2 masculine singular תָּנִיף Deut 23:26 + 2 t., etc.; Imperative masculine plural הָנִ֫יפוּ Isa 13:2 Infinitive construct הָנִיף Isa 10:15 + 2 t.; לַהֲנָפָה Isa 30:28 (Ges«GKC:72z»§ 72z BaNB 90, see also הֲנָחָה), etc.; Participle מֵנִיף Isa 19:16; Zech 2:13, etc.; — swing, wield, wave: —
1. wield, move tool to and fro in using it, with עַלֿ of material: כִּי חֵרְבְּךָ הֵנַפְתָּ עָלֶיהָ Exod 20:25 (E), i.e. over stone, so Deut 27:5; Josh 8:31 (D), and Deut 23:26 a sickle thou shalt not wield over the standing grain of thy neighbour; absolute מְנִיפוֺ Isa 10:15 against him that wieldeth it (i.e. a saw), and כְּהָנִיף שֵׁבֶט וְאֶתמְֿרִימוֺ vIsa 10:15 (read אֶתֿ) like a rod's wielding him that lifteth it.2.Shake or wave the hand;
\ \ a. wave hand אֶלהַֿמָּקוֺם 2Kgs 5:11, in healing ceremony (i.e. probably toward sanctuary KmpKau; > toward the spot [where leprosy appears], so most).
\ \ b. with עַלֿ, shake or brandish against, Isa 11:15; Isa 19:16; Zech 2:13 (all of ׳י) Job 31:21 [compare Eccl 12:18 (without עַל) in mockery].
\ \ c. wave hand, as a signal, Isa 13:2.

3. swing to and fro בְּנָפַת,in a sieve, Isa 30:28 (figurative, of nations).

4. Oft. technical term in P (H), of rite in which originally the priest lifted his share of offering and waved it, i.e. moved it toward altar and back, in token of its presentation to God and its return by him to priest: in H, ׳וְהֵנִיף אֶתהָֿעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי י Lev 23:11a compare vLev 23:11b; vLev 23:12, also vLev 23:20 (on text see Di Dr-WhHpt); in P, וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ אֹתוֺ ׳תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי י Exod 29:26, so Lev 7:30; Lev 8:29; Lev 10:15 (object omitted) Num 6:20 thus also Levites are set apart for service of the priests Num 8:11 (Di strike out see ), vNum 8:13 vNum 8:21, compare vNum 8:14 (׳לִפְנֵי י omitted); but same phr, of entire lamb, with oil, Lev 14:12; Lev 14:24, and of offerings which were burnt, entirely Exod 29:24 (compare vExod 29:25), Lev 8:27 (compare vLev 8:28), or in part Num 5:25 (׳הֵנִיף הַמִּנְחָה לִפְנֵי י), — in these the original significance seems lost; so, clearly, of contributions for tabernacle, = offer ׳הֵנִיף תְּנוּפַת זָהָב לְי Exod 35:22. — compare תְּנוּפָה below
5. Shed abroad (si vera lectio) גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֺת תָּנִיף Ps 68:10 bounteous rain thou didst shed abroad [compare ], but verb not wholly suitable; Lag Gr proposes תַּטִּיף, yet this also questionable. Hoph`al Perfect 3 masculine singular הוּנַף, be waved, Exod 29:27 (P), passive of
